title: Coordinate trace identity: Σ_i (−1)^i θ(L w_i, w without w_i) = tr(A)·θ(w) for θ = dx^I and p_I∘L = A∘p_I (parent step 3)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, I : Fin n → Fin P, and let θ be an n-covector on ℝ^P with θ(v) = det(Matrix.of fun k j => v j (I k)) for every v : Fin n → ℝ^P. Let A : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ be ℝ-linear, and let L : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be any map with (L v)(I k) = (A(p v))_k for all v ∈ ℝ^P and k ∈ Fin n, where p v := WithLp.toLp 2 (fun k => v (I k)) ∈ ℝⁿ. Then for every w : Fin n → ℝ^P, Σ_{i ∈ Fin n} (−1)^i·θ(Fin.cons (L(w i)) (i.removeNth w)) = tr(A)·θ(w), where tr(A) = LinearMap.trace ℝ ℝⁿ A.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (I : Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) (θ : Covector (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (A : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) (L : Euclid P → Euclid P), (∀ v : Fin (m + 1) → Euclid P, θ v = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k j => v j (I k))) → (∀ (v : Euclid P) (k : Fin (m + 1)), L v (I k) = A (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun k' => v (I k'))) k) → ∀ w : Fin (m + 1) → Euclid P, ∑ i : Fin (m + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * θ (Fin.cons (L (w i)) (i.removeNth w)) = LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) A * θ w
